projects.title: Thaura.ai Web Security Testing Automation
projects.description: Automated non-intrusive web security audit framework built with Python and Playwright covering 15 public Thaura.ai pages across 5 core security checks: HTTPS enforcement & mixed-content detection (TC-SEC-01), HTTP security response headers (TC-SEC-02), safe public input validation & sanitization (TC-SEC-03), redacted sensitive data exposure scanning (TC-SEC-04), and cookie security attribute auditing (TC-SEC-05), generating consolidated Excel and screenshot evidence reports.

assertions.name: TC-SEC-01: Enforce HTTPS & zero HTTP mixed-content resources
TC-SEC-02: Validate CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options & X-Content-Type headers
TC-SEC-03: Non-intrusive public input sanitization boundary check
TC-SEC-04: Scan DOM & scripts for sensitive token/key exposure (redacted)
TC-SEC-05: Verify Secure, HttpOnly & SameSite cookie flags
Export Thaura_Security_Testing_Combined_Report.xlsx artifact
